explicit_start: User kick-off 25 September 2026; sections 4–9 and ordered steps approved.

generator.original_structural_acceptance: Existing generator: original canonical START-to-farthest route at least 7 cells and at least 2 turns; unique abstract topology and metric embedding.
generator.duplicate_registry: Existing explicit pure-source registry through maze-view transfer, plus all eight V4 audit specifications; deduplicate identical named registry entries.
generator.assignment: First ten accepted layouts dev-tune, next twenty validation, final sixty sealed test; no outcome-dependent sampling.

sealed_custody.public_registry: Opaque hashes, counts and construction/episode seeds only; sealed geometry and episode packets remain under a new sealed_test_* directory.
sealed_custody.test_episode_note: Kick-off requests episode registration for all sets; reserve two paired test episodes per maze now, with no E1 execution authority.

episodes.distance_rule: Strictly greater on the declared true inflated 20-mm grid.
episodes.selection: Per-episode seeded permutation of distinct ordered cell-centre home/beacon pairs; first pair satisfying clearance, inflated-grid connectivity/distance and wall-occluded line of sight. Heading uniform in [-pi,pi), drawn after pair acceptance; fixed independent simulation seed per episode.
episodes.visibility: Require a maze wall to occlude the straight home-to-beacon segment; no rendering or dependence on initial camera heading.
episodes.source_instruction: Existing mission coordinate instruction in initial body frame; no true map, route or current native pose is supplied. Beacon is the instructed positional destination, as in V4.2; no new visual detector or sensor.
episodes.pairing: Identical geometry, home, heading, beacon and simulation seed for all controllers; episode IDs ordered global_maze_id/episode_index.

definitions.round_trip: Both OUTBOUND and RETURN pass the existing native physical reader; any source failure remains a failure.

spl.shortest_path: True static wall geometry; shortest grid path under declared inflation, diagonal corner crossing forbidden.
spl.actual_path: Native 2-ms base-centre XY path length per leg; failed leg SPL zero; no attempt of return means return SPL zero.

definitions.stall: Number of planning decisions whose final selected action is hold divided by planning decisions with a selection, separately by mission phase; report overrides separately.
definitions.latency: Measured wall duration of each complete planning decision with physics paused; median/p95; retain episode wall time.

safety.disallowed_contacts: Existing native physical-reader contact identity; ordinary support-ground excluded, maze-foot and disallowed body/ground contact included.

controllers.C0: Oracle prediction-slot adapter only: six qualified restored 800-ms candidate branches; no map/pose privileges to harness.
controllers.C1: Existing frozen fitted command-history motion model.
controllers.C2: Existing reactive selector; no future-motion model.

C3.head: maze_data
C3.justification: Existing V4.2 point estimates show lower regret for the maze-data head in both exposure strata; this fixes a choice, not a claim of superiority.

C4.source: One new direct supervised predictor under the fixed training plan below; the completed source/interface inventory found no compatible existing direct predictor.
inventory_evidence: Historical supervised rollout uses the older rollout interface; not the current frozen V-JEPA dense 100–800-ms slot.
Existing DenseVisualMotionReadout requires actual/predicted future features and is not a direct command-conditioned predictor.
C4.training_data: Exactly the selected maze-data readout training populations: 5,966 original/heading contexts and 2,448 maze contexts, targets at every 100–800-ms horizon. No audit, new dev-tune, validation or sealed data used for fitting.
C4.input: Same frozen V-JEPA encoder and native resize/colour/layer-normalisation/spatial-pooling path; causal current/context RGB and past commands, plus candidate applied command tape and requested horizon. No actual future RGB at inference. Recover commands/context from the original training-role recordings only; never impute from new runs.

architecture.token_projection: 1024->32 shared across 192 pooled spatial tokens for each of 3 causal context positions

C4.schedule: 32 old/heading plus 32 maze contexts per batch, fixed seeded shuffled cycles; uniform fixed 100–800-ms horizon schedule.
C4.targets: Same body-relative dx, dy and yaw, same readout target normalisation.
C4.checkpoint: Fixed final update; no outcome-based checkpoint selection or tuning. If a selection diagnostic is run, only existing selection-role data is admissible; new validation mazes are never used.
C4.cap_scope: Includes training feature encoding and fitting; no concurrent harness owner on that GPU.
C4.provenance: Historical training rendering remains unverified; no regeneration authorized by this selection.

harness_v0.definition: Controller stack exactly as deployed in V4.2 source runs; changes for episode binding, prediction-slot adapters, output accounting and replay recording do not change controller algorithms.

oracle_check.requirements: Compare every actually executed candidate prefix against its branch prediction under the matching command tape, including the committed prefix and post-dispatch segment. Physical branch work must restore all source session, recorder and RNG state and leave live controller time unadvanced.

throughput.pilot_C4: Run after the fixed C4 instance is ready; early C0 check serves as its serial pilot, without an unlogged repeat.
throughput.equivalence: Identical decisions and native trajectories on recorded episodes, same device, before using each optimisation; no implicit V4 single-owner restriction.
throughput.pipeline_test_video: One pilot episode; deterministic replay, same decision/pose fidelity checks; clearly labelled pipeline test, excluded from capability statistics.
throughput.projection: Measured per-controller episode and video costs, conservative full-budget source duration, declared harness/gate counts; reduce validation to one episode per maze first if >120 hours; if still over, stop. No post-result trimming.

harness_iteration.initial_C1_episodes: First episode of each dev-tune maze.
harness_iteration.allowed_changes: Brief section 5 only; shared identically by every controller.

qualification.C0_validation: Lowest ten episode IDs, fixed before outcomes.

inference.unit: maze average across its paired episodes
inference.bootstrap: paired resampling of maze IDs within validation

qualification.label: Capability qualification, not paper benchmark results.

videos.selection: Lowest-ID common successful validation episode; else lowest success per controller; else lowest episode labelled failure. Fixed before viewing.
videos.accelerated_cut: 4x with visible label for missions >120 simulated seconds
panels: HUD with capability rate and episode/harness/controller identity

stop: Stop at brief limits, failed six-version gate, or completion of capability report/videos/E1 proposal. E1 execution, moving obstacles, RL, C3 fitting, sensors and hardware remain unauthorized.

correction.single_change: Retire and consume an attained measured-view recovery reference after one second of continuous accepted-pose alignment without inherited strong-support release.
correction.rationale: 05 return and 08 outbound spend 306.4/318.8 seconds holding; 569/578 recovery holds are already aligned within 0.1 rad with a clearance-eligible turn.
correction.expected_effect: End futile attained-reference holding and permit ordinary routing; no claim that other recorded turn-memory or pose-loss mechanisms are fixed.
correction.gate_condition: C1 >=9/10, zero contacts/hard violations and all sampled hard clearance qualified; then unchanged C0 >=19/20 gate.
correction.safety: Any disallowed contact or hard violation disqualifies this version; preserve failures, no automatic retries.

retention.C0: First corrected gate episode full RGB-D, then hash-only after bitwise command replay. Mismatch stops for possible validity problem.
retention.hashes: Every primary and auxiliary RGB array and depth packet actually consumed, typed packet SHA-256; native depth SHA-256 and recipe additionally logged.

reprojection.basis: Measured wall time per complete mission for each controller, including failures; 15% contingency

approval: Approved brief sections 4–9; user 27 September: leg-split timeouts/pose loss, inspect turnaround and outbound-route reuse, flag budget pressure without changing budget, then choose the next change from evidence.
